color.$description: Raw palette. Never used directly by components; semantic tokens point here. Evidence: the original audit

700.$description: PROPOSED: AcmeCo's dark blue, the one brand and action colour. White text 10.98:1.

800.$description: PROPOSED: dark blue hover, one step away from the page background. White text 13.65:1.

900.$description: PROPOSED: dark blue pressed, one step past hover. White text 16.23:1.

700.$description: PROPOSED: error red (decision 7). 7.37:1 with white. Used only for errors, always with an icon and a message.

100.$description: OBSERVED: chip border, rgba(151,201,255,.4) composited onto the #eef7ff chip tint. Decorative.

700.$description: OBSERVED: the one link blue (1,007 el / 11 exp), 6.80:1 on white. Absorbs #0888ba (4.0:1, fails AA), #0c6cc4, #0056b6 and LEGACY-NAMED #0056b3.

800.$description: PROPOSED: link hover. Not observed (hover wasn't captured).

100.$description: OBSERVED: subtle surface (14 exp). Absorbs #f4f4f3 (--legacy-palette-lighter-gray) and #efefef.

200.$description: OBSERVED: default border (12 exp). Absorbs #eaeaea, #e2e2e2 and #e7e8e7 (--legacy-palette-light-gray).

500.$description: PROPOSED: control border (decision 5). Observed #b1b3b0 (337 el / 8 exp) at 2.11:1 fails WCAG 1.4.11; became #808386 at 3.81:1 on white and 3.43:1 on #f3f3f3.

600.$description: OBSERVED, LEGACY-NAMED: --legacy-palette-dark-gray. Secondary text (765 el / 13 exp), 5.77:1 on white.

700.$description: OBSERVED: footer and secondary text (492 el / 11 exp).

900.$description: OBSERVED, LEGACY-NAMED: --legacy-color-ink (1,090 el / 14 exp). Absorbs #000000, #212529 and #333333.

700.$description: PROPOSED: success. Not observed; needed for 'inquiry sent' feedback.

white-85.$description: OBSERVED: translucent controls over photos (seen at 85% and 60%). 85% kept because it holds contrast over dark photos.

brand.$description: PROPOSED: Outfit, AcmeCo's brand typeface, at 400 and 600 (decision 4). Swapping the brand font is this one value.

semibold.$description: PROPOSED: the 'bold' role (decision 4). Observed bold is 700; Outfit 700 reads heavier than the legacy brand typeface bold, and 600 exists as a named style in Figma.

12.$description: OBSERVED: 1,284 el / 8 exp. Absorbs 10 and 11px (raised to 12px minimum for legibility).

14.$description: OBSERVED: 1,579 el / 12 exp. Absorbs 13px (sits between 12 and 14; rounded up for legibility).

16.$description: OBSERVED: the most used size, 3,679 el / 14 exp. Absorbs 15px (1,185 el; sits between 14 and 16; rounded up for legibility).

20.$description: OBSERVED: 1,063 el / 13 exp. 22px sits between 20 and 24, so each component decides.

32.$description: OBSERVED: section headings (28 el). Absorbs 28, 30 and 34px.

line-height.$description: Text up to 20px keeps AcmeCo's 1.5x rhythm (decision 9); larger headings use tighter values.

24.$description: OBSERVED: 16/24, 1.5x, the most common text style.

space.$description: 4px grid (decision 5). Observed: a 5px rhythm (5/10/15/20) beside an 8px one (8/16/24/32/48). Off-grid values move to the nearest step; 10px and 20px sit exactly between two steps, so each component decides.

4.$description: BENCHMARK-INFORMED: 4px grid. Absorbs 15px (4,332 el / 14 exp, the most used padding).

radius.$description: One scale used everywhere (decision 5). Observed: 22 values; 8px on the homepage, 3px on results, 2px on detail.

md.$description: OBSERVED: 475 el / 8 exp. Cards and panels. Absorbs 6px.

lg.$description: LEGACY-NAMED: --legacy-testimonial-radius. Not used by a v1 component: dialogs are 8px surfaces (decision 28).

pill.$description: OBSERVED: 34px filter chips (281 el), 9999px, circles. Chips and the hero search.

offset.$description: PROPOSED: keeps the ring on the page background, never touching a dark blue control (link blue on dark blue is 1.61:1).

raised.$description: OBSERVED: the most widespread shadow (5 exp). Menus, popovers and dialogs (exactly the sign-in modal's shadow, decision 28).

overlay.$description: PROPOSED: a deeper level, not used by a v1 component (dialogs use shadow.raised, decision 28). Observed 24 distinct shadows; the benchmark uses 3 levels.

glow.$description: REFERENCE-OBSERVED, PROPOSED: the reference product's AI glow (several soft green layers, up to 0 4px 20px) as one layer in link blue at 20%. The AI assistant only (decision 29).

gutter.$description: LEGACY-NAMED: --legacy-container-gutter was 15px; became 16px for the 4px grid (decision 5).

breakpoint.$description: Reference values. CSS variables can't be used inside @media, so media queries use these numbers literally.

md.$description: OBSERVED: core-site max-width breakpoint (all three stacks).
